2zu:
Students will learn how to be a savvy leader who can communicate, plan and solve problems effectively. Management is a universal need, so their knowledge and skills will be valued in every field – from corporations to nonprofits to government agencies.

As a management major, students will gain a solid foundation in all aspects of management, including presentational speaking, organizational behavior, human resources, operations management, management information systems, international management and strategic management.

Networking is key in business, and it’s key in the College of Business Administration, too. With Ohio Northern University's small class sizes, students will get to know their professors and they will get to know them. In fact, students will be assigned a faculty advisor who will mentor them from day one until graduation. They will also interact with and learn from business leaders, senior executives, entrepreneurs and Ohio Northern University alumni who’ve forged amazing careers in many different fields.

Upon graduation, students will be ready for whatever the future holds, whether it’s managing a small business workforce, leading project teams for a Fortune 500 company or starting their own business.
30z:
Program Description

Sports isn’t all about the athletes, coaches and competition. It’s also about business. Every sport and athletic enterprise needs people with business skills so at ONU the sport management degree will be a business degree.

At ONU, they’ll prepare students for a successful career in sport management. Their solid curriculum includes a core of 21 business-related courses on which to build a solid foundation of business knowledge needed to help sport organizations be successful in a multi-billion dollar industry. Additionally, sport management-specific courses in the major will give students real-world and practical hands-on learning opportunities and prepare them for the variety of environments they may find in their future career. With these experiences, students will learn to communicate, problem-solve, collaborate and lead. These skills are in demand in high school, collegiate and professional sports.
30m:
Program Description

ONU offers a NAACLS accredited bachelor’s degree program and a post-baccalaureate certificate program in medical laboratory science. Both programs include biology, chemistry, organic chemistry and anatomy courses and emphasize hands-on learning. Students will spend a lot of time experimenting in the sophisticated medical and science labs. There, they’ll work side-by-side with real professors – not graduate assistants or lab instructors.

Large institutions just can’t provide the individualized attention and opportunity students will find at ONU. Their medical laboratory science students experience real-world situations. They practice procedures utilized in today’s laboratories, develop specimen collection skills through participation in numerous health fairs, and collaborate with other health profession students on case studies. They star on sports teams, participate in music ensembles and lead student organizations.
30a:
Program Description

Large institutions just can’t provide the individualized attention and opportunity students will find at ONU. As freshmen, students will work in the lab with real professors – not graduate assistants or lab instructors. Throughout their four years, they'll design and conduct their own experiments, work on independent projects, and assist professors with grant-funded research. Most biology students present their research at regional and national conferences.

As Biology majors, students also have the option to choose a pre-professional track in physical therapy, occupational therapy, physician assistant, pre-optometry, pre-dentistry, pre-veterinary science, or pre-med. From the time they arrive on campus until they graduate, they'll be guided by a faculty advisor. Students will enjoy small class sizes and amazing friendships with their fellow biology majors. ONU's dedicated professors will get to know them. They will support students in their coursework, research, internships, co-ops, post-graduate or career preparations. They will become personally invested in students' success – in college and beyond.
